notes:
Verified against HPE's official "HPE Networking Instant On Switch 1960" data sheet (product no. JL807A; also issued under the earlier "Aruba Instant On 1960 24G 20p Class4 4p Class6 PoE 2XGT 2SFP+ 370W Switch" branding, doc PSN1014132933WWEN/CZEN) and the official "Aruba Instant On 1960 Installation and Getting Started Guide" (Sept 2023, Ed. 4). Direct hpe.com fetches timed out repeatedly, so content was pulled from two independent reseller-hosted mirrors of the identical HPE PDF (promisegulf.com and axilogi.com) whose text matches verbatim, plus a googleapis.com-hosted mirror of the official Aruba installation guide for physical panel confirmation.

Port count/type: 24x RJ-45 10/100/1000 PoE ports (auto-MDI/MDI-X), 2x dedicated 10GBASE-T ports, 2x dedicated SFP+ 10GbE slots — confirmed as 4 separate uplink ports (not a shared/combo dual-personality pair) per the data sheet's port line "24 RJ-45 10/100/1000 PoE (CL4 and CL6) ports, 2 SFP+ 10GbE ports, 2 10GBASE-T ports."

PoE: total shared PoE budget is 370W. Per the installation guide's PoE delivery table, ports 1-4 are Class 6 (up to 60W each) and ports 5-24 are Class 4 (up to 30W each) — this Class4/Class6 split isn't represented in the port schema (no PoE-class field) so it's noted here instead.

No console/CLI port and no USB port exist on this model — confirmed absent from all front-panel diagrams in the installation guide (only RJ-45/SFP+ data ports, LED Mode pushbutton, and a recessed Reset pushbutton are shown); the Instant On 1960 series is managed only via local web GUI, the Instant On mobile app, or the cloud portal.

Rack: 1U (35.05 x 44.25 x 4.4cm; the fanless-clearance note in the install guide explicitly cites "1U (44.45mm/1.75-inch)" confirming a 1U chassis height). Desktop/table-top and wall mounting are also supported.

Exact printed port-number labels for the two 10GBASE-T and two SFP+ uplink ports were not legible in the diagrams reviewed; they are named generically ("25/26 (10GBASE-T)", "SFP+ 1/2") rather than confirmed silkscreen text.

ports.name: SFP+ 1
ports.note: 10GbE SFP+ uplink slot, fiber or DAC via Aruba-supported transceivers

ports.name: SFP+ 2
ports.note: 10GbE SFP+ uplink slot, fiber or DAC via Aruba-supported transceivers

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: Detachable AC power cord to rear inlet; auto-ranging 100-240VAC, 50/60Hz. No power switch. Exact IEC pin variant (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in HPE literature; inferred from installation-guide photography of a standard detachable IEC power cord.
